title: Green and bark [gab]
description: just click to striped log and you grow a barked
body:
green and bark (gab) Allows you to grow bark on hewn trees. While it's not particularly useful, I think it will greatly simplify your gameplay. Instead of searching for new logs for your house, you can use bone meal by simply right-clicking on a hewn tree.

![exemple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b8c9090789d2e5a9a4ba40f82482c0e246161706.gif)

Just press to stripped log a bone meal, and you grow a bark
